title: helperReferences
responsibility: Reads runtime references, construction sites, class declarations, instance methods and forwarding bindings from committed source.

inputs.name: helperReferences.code
inputs.description: Source text to parse into runtime references, forwarding bindings and top-level class facts. Import/export declarations and type nodes are omitted from reference scanning, while export declarations can still contribute forwarding bindings.
examples: import { slugify } from './slugify'; export function title() { return slugify('Hello'); }

inputs.name: helperReferences.svelte
inputs.description: Selects whether code is preprocessed through helperTemplates before parsing. Defaults to false.

outputs.name: helperReferences
outputs.description: Contains recognized runtime references, top-level class facts and export forwarding bindings. Reference facts mark actual new-expression callees and caller scopes, while class facts list named top-level declarations and callable public instance members.
